title: आयु विचार Aayu Bichar
nepali: प्राणीहरूको शरीरलाई जीवन्त बनाउने महत्वपूर्ण तTवलाई आयु भनिन्छ । बालकको पूर्वजन्मको आर्जित फल, मातापिताको कर्मफल, आहार विहार , धर्म संस्कार, शील स्वभावजस्ता कुराहरूले आयु निर्णयमा प्रभाव पार्दछन् । अकाल मृत्युलाई अल्पायु भनिन्छ । सन्ध्याकाल, ग्रहण, उल्कापात, केतुको उदय जस्ता प्राकृतिक विपत्तिका समयमा भएको जन्म शीघ्र मृत्युकारक मानिन्छ ।लग्नको मालिक ग्रह, चन्द्रमा र अन्यग्रहहरूको नीच, अस्त पापयुत, पापदृष्ट, त्रिकस्थानगत जस्तादुर्बल र अशुभ योगका कारण बालकको मृत्यु हुन्छ त्यसलाई बालारिष्ट भनिन्छ । ग्रहहरूले केन्द्र,त्रिकोण र उच्चादि शुभस्थानमा बसेर निर्माण गरेका शुभयोगहरूले अरिष्टको भङ्ग गरेर दीर्घायु जीवनप्रदान गर्दछन् । नैतिकता, आध्यात्मिकता, सुभोजन, सुसंस्कार, योग, साधनाजस्ता कुराहरूले अपरिमितायु प्रदान गर्दछन् । परम धार्मिक, सदाचारी, प्रकृति अनुकूल जीवनयापन गर्ने ,योग तथा मन्त्रसिद्ध व्यक्तिहरूको आयु गणितागत आयुभन्दा धेरै हुन्छ । त्यसैले सिद्ध व्यक्ति, योगी रतपस्वीहरूका लागि गणितागत आयु व्यर्थ मानिन्छ ।
american_english: The vital element that imparts life to the physical bodies of living beings is called lifespan (aayu). Factors such as the fruits earned by a child in a past life, the karmic fruits of parents, diet and lifestyle, religious sacraments, and moral character exert an influence on the determination of lifespan. Untimely death is called short life (alpayu). Birth occurring during times of natural calamities such as twilight, eclipses, meteor showers, and the rising of a comet is considered a cause of swift death. When the death of a child occurs due to weak and inauspicious planetary combinations—such as the lord of the ascendant, the Moon, and other planets being debilitated, combust, conjoined with malefics, aspected by malefics, or placed in trika houses—that is called balarishta. Benefic combinations formed by planets occupying auspicious houses such as quadrants (kendras), trines (trikonas), and exaltations neutralize the affliction and bestow a long life. Factors such as morality, spirituality, wholesome food, noble culture, yoga, and spiritual disciplines bestow an immeasurable lifespan. The lifespan of individuals who are supremely pious, virtuous, live in harmony with nature, and have attained perfection in yoga and sacred mantras is much greater than their mathematically calculated lifespan. Therefore, for realized beings, yogis, and ascetics, mathematically calculated lifespan is considered futile.

translator_notes: Astrological terminology transliterated and explained: aayu (lifespan), alpayu (short life), balarishta (childhood astrological affliction), kendra (quadrant), trikona (trine), and trika (dusthana houses 6, 8, 12). Source typographical artifact तTवलाई interpreted as तत्त्वलाई. Strict 9-sentence order maintained.
